packageJson.title: package.json contents
packageJson.description: Paste the full contents of a package.json file (dependencies, devDependencies, optionalDependencies are read).

requirementsTxt.title: requirements.txt contents
requirementsTxt.description: Paste the contents of a requirements.txt file. Pinned (==) and range specifiers are supported; -r, -e, URL and VCS lines are skipped.

manifestUrls.title: Manifest URLs (raw files)
manifestUrls.description: Optional. Public URLs of RAW package.json or requirements.txt files (for example raw.githubusercontent.com links). The file type is detected from the file name.

packages.title: Extra packages
packages.description: Optional list of extra packages to check, one per entry, such as 'npm:express@4.17.1' or 'pypi:requests==2.25.0'. Version is optional.

includeDevDependencies.title: Include devDependencies
includeDevDependencies.description: Also audit devDependencies and optionalDependencies from package.json.

checkVulnerabilities.title: Check known vulnerabilities (OSV.dev)
checkVulnerabilities.description: Look up known vulnerabilities for the requested version using the free OSV.dev database. Only runs when a concrete version can be determined.

staleAfterDays.title: Stale after (days)
staleAfterDays.description: Flag a package as stale when its latest release is older than this many days.

maxDependencies.title: Maximum dependencies
maxDependencies.description: Safety cap on the number of dependencies analysed (and charged) in one run.
